PASS on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/sallu-786__go2_isaac_ros2 --backend fake (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored (driver.lock.json authored_by deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017, run wD-090) and unreviewed (reviewed_by null); no hardware was attached and no hardware or sim backend was run. No deviation from the card: family-config/GymnasiumDriver expresses the task, because Go2RSLEnvCfg configures the Isaac Lab environment (quadruped/go2/go2_env.py:139) that quadruped/go2/go2_ctrl.py:72 builds with gym.make('Isaac-Velocity-Flat-Unitree-Go2-v0', cfg=cfg); native is the card's first entry symbol. Only the Go2 entry symbol is served; SpotRSLEnvCfg (quadruped/spot/spot_env.py:139) is not covered. NOT COVERED: the upstream Isaac Sim/Isaac Lab environment, which was never built or run (Isaac Sim 4.5.0, Isaac Lab 2.1.x, ROS2 Humble and a GPU are external, README.md:4-8 and :41-43); the sim backend was not exercised and the family driver's gym.make path would use the task's registered default config, not a Go2RSLEnvCfg built from the clone, because package code must not import the clone. NOT COVERED: the full policy observation vector; the fake is a kinematic F0 stand-in that returns a four-number summary, while the real observation concatenates the eight terms of quadruped/go2/go2_env.py:74-94 and the action space is a JointPositionActionCfg over all joints (go2_env.py:61-64). The fake's action and observation widths and bounds are placeholders because the joint count comes from the external UNITREE_GO2_CFG articulation and the term widths from isaaclab mdp, neither stated in the clone, so the real sizes cannot be named from the clone. The fake also models no PhysX, contacts, sensors, ROS2 output or rendering, always returns reward 0 (empty RewardsCfg, go2_env.py:120-123) and never terminates or truncates (empty TerminationsCfg and is_finite_horizon False, go2_env.py:126-129 and :171-172). Warnings, all explained and none failing: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only primes the next reset, so it makes no native call), G7.MAYBE_ABSENT x5 (the Gymnasium interface reset, step, close, action_space and observation_space on a config class whose ManagerBasedRLEnvCfg base is outside the clone), and G8.NO_UNIT x4 (bridge-derived inputs: ticks, seed twice, and action.values in the simulator's own units). No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. No driver-declared Limit or Fact uses a fake number; the action-space bound in the reference is derived by the bridge from the fake environment. The clone root has no LICENSE file, so license_spdx stays NOASSERTION and license_class unknown as in the card. Only cap.world.* catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package; gate.digest is the digest the check printed.
